title: 同意 / 反對
description: 表達同意或反對的用語

sentences.en: I completely agree with the notion that sustainable development, which balances economic and environmental needs, should be our top priority.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意永續發展應該是我們的首要任務這個觀念，它平衡了經濟和環境需求。

sentences.en: While I understand your point of view, I must respectfully disagree with the conclusion you have drawn from the available data.
sentences.zh: 雖然我理解你的觀點，但我必須恭敬地反對你從現有數據中得出的結論。

sentences.en: I could not agree more with the assessment that early intervention, supported by adequate funding, yields the best results.
sentences.zh: 我非常同意這個評估：早期介入在充足資金支持下會產生最好的結果。

sentences.en: With all due respect, I take issue with the assumption that technology alone, without human oversight, can solve complex social problems.
sentences.zh: 恕我直言，我不同意僅靠技術而無需人類監督就能解決複雜社會問題的假設。

sentences.en: I wholeheartedly support the proposal to expand public transportation, which would reduce traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 我全心支持擴展大眾運輸的提案，這將減少交通擁堵並降低碳排放。

sentences.en: I beg to differ on this matter because the evidence, collected over several decades, clearly points in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 在這件事上我有不同看法，因為數十年來收集的證據明確指向相反的方向。

sentences.en: You raise an excellent point, and I think your argument, built upon solid research, deserves serious consideration from the committee.
sentences.zh: 你提出了一個很好的觀點，我認為你基於扎實研究的論點值得委員會認真考慮。

sentences.en: I am afraid I cannot endorse that approach, primarily because it overlooks the needs of vulnerable populations who depend on these services.
sentences.zh: 恐怕我無法認可那個方法，主要是因為它忽略了依賴這些服務的弱勢族群的需求。

sentences.en: That is precisely what I have been thinking, and I am glad someone finally articulated the idea in such a clear and compelling manner.
sentences.zh: 那正是我一直在想的，我很高興終於有人以如此清晰且令人信服的方式表達了這個想法。

sentences.en: I fundamentally oppose the decision to cut funding for arts programs, which have proven to enhance student engagement and academic performance.
sentences.zh: 我從根本上反對削減藝術課程資金的決定，這些課程已被證明能提升學生的參與度和學業表現。

sentences.en: I share your concern about the environmental impact, and I believe that immediate action, coordinated at the international level, is warranted.
sentences.zh: 我和你一樣擔憂環境影響，我認為在國際層面協調的立即行動是有必要的。

sentences.en: I cannot support a policy that, despite its stated intentions, disproportionately affects low-income families who are already struggling.
sentences.zh: 我無法支持一項儘管其聲明意圖良好，卻不成比例地影響已經在掙扎中的低收入家庭的政策。

sentences.en: You have convinced me that the alternative plan, incorporating feedback from all stakeholders, represents a more balanced approach.
sentences.zh: 你已經說服我，那個納入所有利害關係人回饋的替代方案代表了一個更平衡的方法。

sentences.en: I strongly object to the characterization of our efforts as inadequate, given the limited resources with which we have been working.
sentences.zh: 鑑於我們一直在有限的資源下工作，我強烈反對將我們的努力描述為不足。

sentences.en: There is much truth in what you say, and the research findings, published in peer-reviewed journals, certainly lend weight to your argument.
sentences.zh: 你說的很有道理，發表在同行評審期刊上的研究結果確實為你的論點增添了分量。

sentences.en: I must take exception to that claim because it misrepresents the findings of the study, which was conducted under strict protocols.
sentences.zh: 我必須對那個說法提出異議，因為它錯誤地呈現了該研究的發現，而該研究是在嚴格規程下進行的。

sentences.en: I am entirely in favor of the initiative to promote digital literacy, recognizing that these skills are indispensable in the modern workforce.
sentences.zh: 我完全贊成推廣數位素養的倡議，認識到這些技能在現代職場中是不可或缺的。

sentences.en: Although I appreciate the effort behind this proposal, I remain unconvinced that it addresses the root causes of the problem we face.
sentences.zh: 雖然我欣賞這項提案背後的努力，但我仍不相信它解決了我們所面臨問題的根本原因。

sentences.en: I echo your sentiments regarding the need for reform, and I believe that collaborative action, taken swiftly, can bring about real change.
sentences.zh: 我呼應你對改革必要性的看法，並且我相信迅速採取的協作行動能帶來真正的改變。

sentences.en: I respectfully decline to accept that interpretation, which, in my view, oversimplifies a nuanced issue requiring careful analysis.
sentences.zh: 我恭敬地拒絕接受那個解讀，在我看來，它過度簡化了一個需要仔細分析的微妙問題。

sentences.en: Your analysis aligns perfectly with what I have observed in practice, confirming that our current strategy is indeed on the right track.
sentences.zh: 你的分析與我在實務中觀察到的完全一致，證實我們目前的策略確實在正確的軌道上。

sentences.en: I have serious reservations about the proposed timeline, which seems unrealistic given the complexity of the tasks that need to be completed.
sentences.zh: 我對提議的時程表有嚴重的保留意見，考慮到需要完成的任務的複雜性，它似乎不切實際。

sentences.en: I am inclined to agree with you on this point, especially considering the compelling evidence that has emerged from recent studies.
sentences.zh: 在這一點上我傾向於同意你的看法，特別是考慮到近期研究中出現的令人信服的證據。

sentences.en: I vehemently disagree with the suggestion that we should reduce our investment in research, the very engine of innovation and progress.
sentences.zh: 我強烈反對我們應該減少研究投資的建議，研究正是創新和進步的引擎。

sentences.en: I concur with the committee's recommendation that the project, having exceeded its initial budget, requires a thorough financial review.
sentences.zh: 我同意委員會的建議，即該項目在超出初始預算後需要進行徹底的財務審查。

sentences.en: While your argument has some merit, I would contend that it fails to account for the cultural factors that significantly influence behavior.
sentences.zh: 雖然你的論點有一些道理，但我認為它未能考慮到顯著影響行為的文化因素。

sentences.en: I stand firmly behind the decision to implement stricter regulations, which are designed to protect consumers from predatory practices.
sentences.zh: 我堅定地支持實施更嚴格法規的決定，這些法規旨在保護消費者免受掠奪性行為的侵害。

sentences.en: I find myself unable to agree with the majority opinion, primarily because it ignores the long-term consequences that will inevitably unfold.
sentences.zh: 我發現自己無法同意多數人的意見，主要是因為它忽略了必然會展開的長期後果。

sentences.en: That resonates deeply with my own experience, and I think anyone who has worked in this field would recognize the truth in your words.
sentences.zh: 那與我自己的經驗深深共鳴，我認為任何在這個領域工作過的人都會認同你話語中的真實性。

sentences.en: I am opposed to any measure that, however well-meaning, undermines the fundamental rights that citizens have fought so hard to secure.
sentences.zh: 我反對任何措施，無論其用意多麼良好，只要它損害了公民為之奮鬥已久才獲得的基本權利。
